content: AeroSpace: Package.swift (tools 6.2, .swift-version 6.4.0, macOS 13) with targets PrivateApi (C header declaring _AXUIElementGetWindow), Common, AppBundle (library), AeroSpaceApp exec, Cli, AppBundleTests (XCTest).
